name: Fits in a post
description: Your point in 280 characters or fewer, for X, Bluesky or Threads.
author: Whisper Unchained
prompt:
Rewrite the text as a single social media post of at most 280 characters, counting spaces.

- Keep the speaker's main point and their voice.
- No hashtags and no emoji unless the speaker used them.
- If it cannot all fit, keep the main point and drop the supporting detail. Never go over 280 characters.

Example:
I've been thinking about this a lot and honestly I think the best productivity trick, like the only one that's ever worked for me, is just writing down three things the night before
becomes:
The only productivity trick that has ever worked for me: write down three things the night before.
